name: rebound-ops
description: Evidence-led career recovery: Angular app, localhost API and typed contracts

scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:api && node --test tests/*.test.mjs packages/contracts/tests/*.test.mjs apps/api/tests/*.test.mjs evals/ai-review/*.test.mjs evals/autofill/*.test.mjs evals/eligibility/*.test.mjs scripts/*.test.mjs engine/web/tests/lib/apply-answer-policy.test.mjs engine/web/tests/lib/apply-answer-note.test.mjs engine/web/tests/lib/apply-profile-facts.test.mjs engine/web/tests/lib/apply-drive-write-guard.test.mjs engine/web/tests/lib/apply-narrative-draft.test.mjs engine/web/tests/lib/apply-approved-answers.test.mjs engine/web/tests/lib/apply-fill-readback.test.mjs engine/web/tests/lib/apply-repeated-sections.test.mjs engine/web/tests/lib/apply-lever.test.mjs engine/web/tests/lib/eligibility-screen.test.mjs && npm run test:web
